title: 1932 New war memorial placed in front of school
description: The new Hartland War Memorial, a 20-foot marble monument, was placed on the school grounds in July 1933 by the Hartland Branch of the Canadian British Empire Service League. Engraved on the front are the names of local heroes who made the supreme sacrifice during World War. The unveiling ceremony, shown in this photo, took place at 2:30 p.m. on Armistice Day, November 11, 1933. One of two mothers whose sons fell in WWI performed the unveiling. Veterans stood in military formation by the memorial as the Hartland Band played appropriate music. Many returned soldiers from Hartland and nearby communities attended the event.
